text: 1. Art theory research: Integrating the methods of Chinese and Western humanities, studying the history of art, art theory, art literature and history of art history at home and abroad, and conducting thematic research on artists, art works, art thoughts and other fields in the history of art at home and abroad.2. Chinese painting creation and research: Based on traditional Chinese painting theory and creation method, learn from and absorb modern ideas and methods of various art categories, study relevant theories of Chinese painting creation, explore modern forms of painting techniques and material expression, and create excellent modern Chinese painting works.3. Oil painting creation and research: including oil painting, gouache watercolor, acrylic and composite material painting. To cultivate painting creation and teaching talents needed by modern society, cultivate professional talents with solid painting theories and skills, good sense of inheritance and modern concepts, understand the development trend and latest achievements of painting profession, and can engage in painting creation, art dissemination and research of related disciplines.4. Calligraphy creation and research: The major of calligraphy emphasizes the inheritance of excellent traditions of calligraphy and the cultivation of innovative creative ability of calligraphy, while focusing on the reference of related disciplines and professions, striving to improve the comprehensive quality of students and cultivate the ability of students to engage in calligraphy research with multidisciplinary knowledge.5. Sclpture creation and research: Based on Chinese and Western sculpture theories and creation methods, it draws on and absorbs modern comprehensive materials and new media artistic expression means, studies relevant theories of sculpture creation, combines environmental art and public art in sculpture creation, and expands the expression forms of sculpture art.6. Modern decoration and design research: Cultivate comprehensive artistic talents with decorative art concept, creative practice and theoretical research of decorative art. Decorative art design mainly includes the theory and practice courses of decorative graphics, traditional decorative art, modern decorative art, public art, environmental art, etc., aiming at cultivating students' composite knowledge and skills of academic research and creative practice ability of decorative art.
